NEW
10 CLS
20 MOVE 23,14
30 X=PEEK(16369);Y=PEEK(16370)
40 MOVE 0,0
50 FOR I=1 TO 20
60 PRINT I
70 NEXT I
80 MOVE 2+5,1+2
90 C=PEEK(16369);D=PEEK(16370);R=PEEK(16368)
100 Z=PEEK(4016+R)
110 CLS
120 IF X#23 THEN 900
130 IF Y#1 THEN 900
140 IF C#7 THEN 900
150 IF D#12 THEN 900
160 IF Z#84 THEN 900
170 COLOR 2;TC. 31
180 PRINT "MOVE SCROLL PASS"
190 STOP
900 COLOR 1;TC. 31
910 PRINT "MOVE SCROLL FAIL"
920 STOP
RUN
